test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusion numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide 

Which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All creepers are vegetables.

All vegetables are fruits.

Some fruits are flowers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some creepers are flowers.

II. Some fruits are creepers.

III. All vegetables are flowers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusion I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

All creepers are vegetables.

All vegetables are fruits.

Some fruits are flowers.

__**Venn**__** **__**Diagram**__**:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e6830d7181033d85781aec13e41455565739755b95e8a7ae77f873e1a758d90.png] 

__**Conclusions**__**:**

I. Some creepers are flowers → Does not follow → We have no information which suggests the relationship between creepers and flowers so we cannot assume anything and thus the conclusion does not follow.

II. Some fruits are creepers→ Follow → Since all creepers are fruits, they both are directly related to each other & the same can be seen in the Venn diagram so we can say that some fruits are creepers therefore the conclusion follows.

III. All vegetables are flowers→ Does not follow → We have 'All vegetables are fruits' and 'Some fruits are flowers' which means vegetables and flowers are directly not related to each other so the conclusion does not follow.

So **only conclusion II follows.**

Hence,** the correct answer is option 2).**
